name: Zalcano

mechanics.name: Melee Attack
mechanics.description: She swings at whoever is standing next to her while she is up.
mechanics.counterplay: Mine from the far side of the rock rather than beside her.

mechanics.name: Ranged and Magic
mechanics.description: She throws at range too, so distance does not take you out of the fight.
mechanics.counterplay: Keep your health up. There is nowhere in the cavern she cannot reach.

mechanics.name: Golems
mechanics.description: She raises golems out of the rock. They chase you and burst when killed.
mechanics.counterplay: Kill them away from where people are mining, and step clear when they go.

mechanics.name: Rock Fall
mechanics.description: She brings rock down from the ceiling onto marked patches of the floor.
mechanics.counterplay: Move off the marked tiles. The warning is on the ground, not on her.

mechanics.name: Downed
mechanics.description: Enough damage from the imbued tephra knocks her off her feet, and while she is down her defences are gone.
mechanics.counterplay: Get every scrap of damage in before she stands back up. That window is the whole fight.

_note: SKELETON, NOT LIVE-VERIFIED. Ids come from Jagex's own gameval names rather than guesses, but nothing here has been confirmed in a live fight. Provenance: gamevals from runelite-api 1.12.35 (net.runelite.api.gameval.*), because this cache download ships an empty GAMEVALS index (idx24) and ScanGameVal cannot read it; npc names, models, sequences and extents from the live cache (revision of 2026-08-06). Npc ids 9049, 9050 and 12124. 9050 is the fallen state, carrying a different model (38589) and the fallen standing animation 8438, and is in npcIds because it is a transform rather than a new spawn (docs/DECISIONS.md D17); it doubles as an npc-spawn trigger on the downed mechanic. THIS IS THE BEST-NAMED SKILLING BOSS IN THE CACHE, which is why it reads like a combat boss where Wintertodt and Tempoross do not. The ZALCANO_* set covers every mechanic in the fight without a single inference: ATTACK_MELEE 8431, ATTACK_RANGED 8432, ATTACK_MAGIC 8433, ATTACK_GOLEM 8434, ATTACK_ROCK_FALL 8435, and the three downed sequences FALL_DOWN 8437, FALLEN_IDLE 8438 and STAND_UP 8439. The dozens of HUMAN_MINING_ZALCANO_* animations are the player's own pickaxe swings and are correctly not curated. ZALCANO_PENTAGRAM 8442, ZALCANO_FURNACE 8443 and ZALCANO_RUNECRAFT 8444 are the skilling steps rather than anything she does, and are also left out. THE RANGED AND MAGIC ATTACKS SHARE ONE MECHANIC despite having separate animations, because neither is prayable in this fight and the counterplay is identical; splitting them would say the same sentence twice. No projectile is curated: the cache names no ZALCANO spotanim with an unambiguous projectile suffix. THE GOLEMS DETECT ON HER SUMMON ANIMATION RATHER THAN ON THE GOLEMS, because the cache holds a dozen npcs named some variant of golem, all of them ordinary ones from elsewhere in the game, and none marked as belonging to this fight; an npc-spawn on any of them would fire in the wrong place. staticFallback is false on all five; whether each body animation reads has not been eyeballed in game. The collection log page is titled 'Zalcano', matching 'name'.
